ThingDef.label: HG-11
ThingDef.description: This pistol is deployed as a sidearm in the EDF infantry. It uses specialized AP ammunition and combines excellent penetration and stopping power. However, it could not be an effective countermeasure against alien invaders.

ThingDef.label: AF-14
ThingDef.description: EDF standard assault rifle. It has average power, but is very easy to handle and to set up a barrage. Although it is becoming obsolete, many are still deployed.

ThingDef.label: AF-16
ThingDef.description: An improved assault rifle, the AF-14's design was fundamentally revised to create a completely new structure. It has improved power, rapid-fire performance, and accuracy.

ThingDef.label: AF-18
ThingDef.description: Innovative assault rifle. The design of the previous model was further reviewed and redesigned for higher performance. The result is a completely new look and higher performance than the AF16. However, only the range is shorter.

ThingDef.label: AF-20
ThingDef.description: The latest assault rifle, an upper version of the AF18, with enhanced performance in almost every aspect. The extended range has greatly increased its versatility.

ThingDef.label: AF-99
ThingDef.description: The final type of assault rifle. Designed with the best of technology, it was perfected as an excellent firearm that could display its power on any battlefield. It is a great gun, considered the best of the AF series.

ThingDef.label: AF-100
ThingDef.description: The ultimate and most powerful assault rifle. Even alien technology has been incorporated to achieve a significant improvement in performance. While it is an assault rifle, it has the same power as a medium caliber cannon, and if handled properly, it has the power to break through the war situation.

ThingDef.label: AF-14RA
ThingDef.description: Derivative model of the AF14 with emphasis on rapid-fire performance. Although the power per shot is reduced, it compensates by firing bullets at more than double the rate.

ThingDef.label: AF-16RA
ThingDef.description: New RA model. It is capable of firing continuously at a higher rate while achieving a slight increase in power. It is a weapon that shows its true value at close range.

ThingDef.label: AF-20RAR
ThingDef.description: Final RA model. The barrel is now a Gatling system, which enables continuous firing at a very high rate. It can be safely called a hand-held aircraft machine gun.

ThingDef.label: AF14ST
ThingDef.description: Derivative model of the AF14 with increased one-shot power. Because it uses special AP rounds, its penetrating power is also reasonably high, and it can strike even heavily armored opponents.

ThingDef.label: AF20ST
ThingDef.description: Improved ST model. One shot is now heavier and can inflict fatal damage with a few shots, and the penetrating power has also been greatly increased.

ThingDef.label: AF99ST
ThingDef.description: The last model of ST model. With a power and penetrating capability beyond that of an assault rifle, it became an intense firearm that could strike at any opponent.

ThingDef.label: PA-11
ThingDef.description: Standard assault rifle. It has a high level of ease of use and basic performance, but is obsolete within the EDF. However, since it was manufactured and deployed in large numbers, it continues to be used by many units.

ThingDef.label: T1 Stork
ThingDef.description: A new assault rifle, developed based on a different concept from the PA11, with excellent basic performance, ease of handling, and expandability, and supported by many soldiers.

ThingDef.label: T3 Stork
ThingDef.description: A new model of the Stokes assault rifle, based on the T1 Stokes, with various improvements, and with a sequential increase in performance.

ThingDef.label: T5 Stork
ThingDef.description: The latest Stokes assault rifle. Compared to existing models, it has gained overwhelming performance and is renowned as a masterpiece.

ThingDef.label: TZ Stork
ThingDef.description: The ultimate and most powerful stoke assault rifle, which was finally completed by fully introducing innovative technology and even applying alien technology. It is truly a trump card to defeat invading organisms.

ThingDef.label: MA9 Slade
ThingDef.description: A large assault rifle newly developed for elite units. Its performance is powerful and unmatched in a word, and it is said to be able to conquer a battlefield even with a single rider if carried by an experienced soldier.

ThingDef.label: MA10 Slade
ThingDef.description: It is an improved version of the MA9 and is the ultimate most powerful live assault rifle operated by the EDF; only a few were produced for the EDF's most elite units, but even so it is a super-weapon with more than enough power.

ThingDef.label: M1 Raven
ThingDef.description: A rapid-firing assault rifle designed for close-range combat. It is designed to compensate for its low power by firing in rapid succession, making it suitable for use in a barrage of bullets.

ThingDef.label: M3 Raven
ThingDef.description: Upper version of M1 Raven. The multi-barreled design further improves rapid-firing performance, allowing a single shooter to form a dense barrage.

ThingDef.label: M5 Raven
ThingDef.description: The final type of rapid-firing assault rifle. The barrage of bullets released from the tremendous rapid-fire rate is like a storm, and can overwhelm the enemy with many times the number of shots. Its usefulness at close range goes without saying.

ThingDef.label: G&M-21S
ThingDef.description: Marksman-type rifle that uses special armor-piercing rounds. It is a semi-automatic rifle, so it is not effective for continuous firing, but the power of a single shot is more than enough.

ThingDef.label: G&M-A23
ThingDef.description: New G&M rifle. The power of a single shot has been further increased and is capable of damaging even heavily armored opponents.

ThingDef.label: G&M-A25
ThingDef.description: The G&M rifle has been further improved. The impact force of the bullets has also been increased, so even if you defend against the bullets, you will not remain unscathed.

ThingDef.label: G&M-A29
ThingDef.description: The last model of the G&M rifle. It gained enough power and penetration to penetrate through several layers of thick armor, making it a weapon that can strike a painful blow even against heavily armored enemies. It is still semi-automatic due to its construction, but it is still powerful.
